meta.title: VibeIDEA — an open PhpStorm-class IDE with an agent inside
meta.description: An IntelliJ fork with an agent: PHP, TypeScript and CSS out of the box, any agent or model, fuses, a design detector and a slop detector
lang.label: Language
lang.ru.name: Русский
lang.en.name: English
hero.eyebrow: IntelliJ fork · PhpStorm class · open source
hero.title: An IDE where the agent
hero.lead:
PHP, TypeScript and CSS work right after install
Any agent: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or a model on your own key
And fuses stop it before it burns tokens for nothing
hero.note:
No account
macOS, Windows and Linux
JetBrains platform
hero.ide.aria: VibeIDEA window: the agent edits PHP code, a fuse watches the run, the design check found an issue
hero.ide.ask: Add a discount for regular customers
facts.langs.text: Servers ship with the IDE, the PHP and Node runtimes come from your machine
facts.design.text: The design detector measures a live page in two viewports
facts.agents.text: Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI over ACP, or models on your own keys
langs.title:
You open a project
And everything is already highlighted
langs.lead:
Language servers ship with the IDE: nothing to install
Your own server, if you have one, always wins over the bundled one
Switch a branch and the servers refresh themselves
langs.prism: A prism of languages: servers for PHP, TypeScript, CSS, Tailwind, Vue, Svelte, Astro, Angular and others turn around the IDE
langs.debug: Debugging is out of the box too: set a breakpoint and press «Debug»
agent.title: An agent instead of a chat
agent.lead:
Connect your own agent over ACP or work with a model directly
On your own keys or on a ChatGPT Plus and Pro subscription, no key needed
Plans survive an IDE restart, and spending is shown by role and by file
agent.modes.title: Permission modes
agent.mode.autopilot.text: The agent decides itself, the irreversible still asks
agent.mode.edits.text: Edits files itself, asks before shell commands
agent.mode.plan.text: Only reads and proposes, writes are refused
agent.irreversible: Irreversible commands always ask, even on autopilot
fuses.title:
Fuses
Not promises
fuses.lead:
An agent going round in circles burns your money
Every fuse names the reason in words and stops the run instead of writing to a log
fuses.aria: The agent repeats one action four times in a row, the loop detector stops the run and names the reason
fuses.stop: Loop detector: four identical calls in a row
fuses.list.stall: Stall detector: turns go on, files do not change
fuses.list.refusals: N refusals out of the last M
detectors.title:
Checked by numbers
Not by opinion
detectors.design.title: Design detector
detectors.design.text:
85 rules on a live page in two viewports: contrast, tap targets, clipped text, forms, accessibility
And taste: signs of a generated look, typography, rhythm, colour, motion
Every finding comes with a selector and a measured value
detectors.design.aria: A beam scans the page, findings with measurements pop up
detectors.slop.title: Slop detector
detectors.slop.text:
The agent's texts are checked against a catalogue of machine-writing signs in Russian and English
Clichés, empty phrases, rhetorical templates and rhythm, with the line and a way to fix it
detectors.slop.aria: Machine-text clichés light up in a paragraph
features.title: And more
features.telegram.title: Telegram bridge
features.telegram.text: A task from your phone, a daily summary and buttons to confirm dangerous commands
features.watch.title: Video and audio in the chat
features.watch.text: The /watch command: the model watches a video frame by frame and listens to the sound
features.council.title: Model council
features.council.text: The /council command: one question to several different models, each answers without seeing the others
features.server.title: Vibe Server
features.server.text: A dev stack in one file: services, their dependencies and start waves
features.journal.title: Decision journal
features.journal.text: The agent starts knowing what was already rejected and why
features.themes.title: Eight themes
features.themes.text: Seven dark and one light, a dense interface by default
family.title:
Three tools
One set of rules
family.lead:
Both IDEs read the same project rules and settings
And the agents' memory links them across sessions and machines
family.vibeidea: An IDE on the IntelliJ platform for PHP and TypeScript
family.vibeide: An editor built on VS Code with its own agent
family.vibememory: Shared memory for agents: context outlives sessions and machines
install.title: What your machine needs
install.lead:
We do not ship runtimes on purpose: a second interpreter in the build would need updating at every vulnerability
Whatever is missing, the IDE tells you in words and offers a button to install it
releases.title: Latest builds
releases.all: All versions and release notes — on GitHub
firstRun.title: First launch: the system will ask you to confirm
firstRun.lead:
The build is not signed with a publisher certificate yet
The system says it cannot verify the publisher, not that it found anything bad
firstRun.macos: macOS: open «System Settings → Privacy & Security» and click «Open Anyway»
firstRun.windows: Windows: in the SmartScreen window click «More info», then «Run anyway»
cta.title: Open your project in VibeIDEA
cta.lead:
The JetBrains platform under Apache 2.0, our code under AGPL-3.0
No subscription, your code stays with you
footer.tagline: An open PhpStorm-class IDE with an agent inside
